info.name: Campus Lost and Found Portal API
info.description:
Postman test suite for the Campus Lost and Found Portal (Express + MongoDB).

34 requests covering authentication, item CRUD, search/filters, ownership rules, the claim workflow and admin authorisation.

Run the collection top-to-bottom with the 'Campus Lost and Found - Local' environment; tokens and ids are captured automatically by the test scripts.

item.description: Signup, login and role-based access. Successful logins store tokens for the rest of the run.
